abstracted_predicate.name: INTEGRATES_MULTIPLE_OBSERVATIONS_INTO_UNIFIED_REPRESENTATION
abstracted_predicate.definition: The reasoning combines content from multiple distinct observations into a single integrated representation, model, summary, schema, or correspondence structure, rather than treating those observations independently. This includes deriving a unified representation by cross-referencing observed information and, where the observations expose differing fields, attributes, or schema elements, specifying how those elements correspond to or align within the common representation.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text that integrates, cross-references, or maps content from multiple observations into a unified representation or correspondence structure.

parameters.name: observations
parameters.description: The distinct observations whose contents, structures, fields, or attributes are combined or aligned into the unified representation.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning references or restates content from at least two distinct observations.
The reasoning produces a single integrated representation, model, summary, schema, or correspondence structure that combines or relates the observed information.
The reasoning cross-references or aligns elements across observations to a common representation rather than only listing the observations independently.

When the observations contain differently named fields, attributes, or schema elements, the reasoning may specify equivalences or correspondences between those elements and a common target representation.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning references only one observation.
The reasoning lists observations independently without deriving any combined representation, cross-observation alignment, or correspondence.
No integrated understanding, unified model, schema, summary, or mapping to a common representation is stated.
